The Trillion-Dollar Question Nobody Really Has a Good Answer To - Where Is the ROI?

We spend a lot of time debating how many GW of AI compute will come online. But the bigger question is: who ultimately pays for all of it, and can the economics justify trillions of dollars in investment?

I find it helpful to think about AI economics as a chain:

CapEx → Compute / Inference Revenue → Model / API Revenue → End Demand
